title: Ostomy Supply Program Interest-Free Payment Plans
content:
**Patient financial terms - Ostomy Supply Program.** A payment plan is set up when the customer asks to pay the program's balance in monthly installments, on a tier where payment plans are offered and for a balance of at least the tier's smallest plan balance; the customer accepts it personally, and it is recorded as an approved payment plan request carrying the number of monthly installments and the monthly installment.

## When the installment is fixed

1. The plan's installment is fixed only after the program's most recent refill shipped expedited at the customer's request carries its expedited shipping charge.
2. A payment plan's installment is not set until the expedited shipping charge posted against the program's most recent shipment sent expedited at no charge carries its billing correction.
3. A payment plan's installment is not worked out until the records carry a non-covered item charge against the most recent convex-barrier refill whose original claim the plan denied under its organization determination denial.

Each of these is a condition on the records: while the state it names is not yet shown on the program, the installment is not fixed.

## Effect of acceptance

Acceptance records an approved payment plan request on the enrollment carrying the number of monthly installments and the monthly installment the customer agreed to, logged with the moment of acceptance; the plan then shows in the enrollment's customer requests as approved.

## Accepting the plan: `accept_payment_plan_7a7f8df9`

`accept_payment_plan_7a7f8df9` is the customer's own tool. The representative unlocks it (`unlock_user_discoverable_tool`) and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to accept the interest-free payment plan for the balance on their own Ostomy Supply Program enrollment.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `ostomy_program_id` | The reference number of the customer's Ostomy Supply Program enrollment the plan covers, as the representative reads it from the enrollment lookup and tells the customer | Identifier |
| `plan_months` | The number of monthly installments in the plan | A whole number of months, at least 1 |
| `monthly_amount_usd` | The monthly installment in USD, as the representative states it | USD with 2 decimal places; the tool stores it rounded to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** On success the receipt carries `status` ("accepted" when the plan was recorded), `ostomy_request_id` (the reference number of the payment plan request), `ostomy_program_id` (the enrollment covered), `request_status` (always "approved"), `plan_months` (integer months), `monthly_amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places) and `received_at` (the moment of acceptance, exactly as the system clock records it). No other return is defined.
